body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 11f18eda30b9b20d869fea5a0a4396026d650e11 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. Safety-tier review. No blocking findings.

I read the complete diff and checked the current upstream laws. The acknowledgment checks the source and stock fingerprints. The exception applies only when the program stays in one setup on the column engine. Changed columns remain gouges. Opening a project clears the acknowledgment.

Checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-4066`. Trial merge: `dd94e64824b08c6ec20e65932f5579bf2fa13968`, with upstream main `aef12fea67e0082e7ba835a3d9fcade8e2c11eb0`. Its first parent is the reviewed PR head.

- Quick gate: 354 steps; 2,828 tests passed, 36 ignored, one pre-existing failure. All 350 app suites passed.
- App unit tests: 315 passed. These include the fresh-gouge and lattice checks.
- `keep_law`: 36 passed, including all five new acknowledgment tests.
- UI `operations`: 31 passed. UI `shell`: 20 passed, one failed.
- App clippy, all targets, with `-D warnings`: passed.
- Release light lane: all six steps passed; 11 tests passed. Steps: motion `lib`, `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, and app `pocket_pass_start`, plus the build.

Extra suites run:

- `example_catalog`: 43 passed, four ignored.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: one passed.
- `solid_law_goldens`: seven passed.

These suites ran by name in the quick gate. No fixture or importer change requires additional kernel suites. No golden or recorded program changed in this PR. Full heavy lanes were not run, as the current law reserves them for the cut.

Safety input mutations, run locally through the PR tests:

- Remove the acknowledgment: posting is RED as expected; the control test is GREEN.
- Add the bore that deepens the incoming step by 3 mm: posting is RED as expected; the located-gouge test is GREEN.
- Keep the acknowledged step unchanged: posting is GREEN with the located 5.00 mm note.
- Reopen the project: posting is RED again; the reset test is GREEN.

No source-code mutation was applied.

Pre-existing failure:

`crates/ui/tests/shell.rs:12`, `headless_cli_exit_code_is_zero`, fails with:

```text
assertion `left == right` failed
  left: 1
 right: 0
```

I ran the same complete shell suite on bare upstream main `034e91b8b78fa64989d18e1d5d17344531c4762c`. It has the same failure, with 20 tests passed and one failed. This host failure does not block this PR. I did not identify a tracking issue.

Requested before merge: none.

The review worktree and branch remain in place to keep the build warm. No PR code was changed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

I pushed review fixes in `3c4e3b7b8`. Two independent reviews of the first version found six cases. Each one now has a pinning test in `keep_law/incoming_stock_deficits` that fails without its fix, for 16 tests in that module:

1. A program of touch probes only was refused even with the acknowledgment. It is now judged and noted the same way (#108).
2. A torch or wire program keeps the full gate. Unchanged column tops cannot show what such a program left alone (#670).
3. An undercut program keeps the full gate, because an undercut pass lowers no column top (#1444).
4. A probe in a setup other than the judged one never uses that setup's acknowledgment.
5. A program that cuts nothing is now judged on the setup it runs in, not on the first setup's stock. `carry::walk` takes its steps from the program's own operations when nothing is planned. Cutting programs walk exactly as before. This changes the ordinary verdict (acknowledgment off) for programs of probes or torches only.
6. Across setups the walk cannot cross, such a program now refuses by name and writes no NC file. Before, it posted.

Checks on `3c4e3b7b8`:
- Quick gate against `upstream/main`: 353 of 354 steps passed. The one failure was a stale CRLF working copy of the committed `eol=lf` Sinumerik kit file, which this PR does not touch. After the copy was restored, that suite passed 3 of 3.
- Clippy passed on all `camcraft-app` targets with warnings denied.
- 179 of 179 tests passed in 21 related suites.

The PR body is updated, with a changelog line. Ready for a re-check.
